name: week
title: Access review week
subtitle: Fictional records until replaced with your own evidence

sections.title: Campaign progress
sections.sql: select * from access.campaign_summary order by due_on

sections.title: Pending reviews
sections.sql: select email,application,entitlement,reviewer_email,overdue_days from access.review_queue where campaign_status='open' and decision='pending' order by overdue_days desc

sections.title: Removal evidence
sections.note: A decision to remove access does not change another system.

sections.title: Recorded findings
sections.sql: select rule,email,application,finding from access.compliance_findings f join access.register g on g.id=f.id order by rule,email

sections.title: Privileged or unclassified access
sections.sql: select email,application,entitlement,privileged,observed_on from access.register where privileged is distinct from false and observed_status<>'removed'
